summary: Build practical supplier screening, risk assessment, and performance scorecard skills. Explore the five-day vendor management course and enrol.
lede: Vendor pre-qualification and management helps procurement and contract professionals assess suppliers before award and monitor delivery after onboarding. You will practise drafting RFIs, validating supplier evidence, applying weighted evaluations and recording risks in a supplier register. The course also covers onboarding controls and performance scorecards, with introductory attention to AI-assisted screening, data quality and human review.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who evaluate suppliers, approve onboarding, manage contracts, or monitor vendor delivery and risk.
prerequisites: No formal procurement qualification is specified as a prerequisite. Familiarity with purchasing, supplier onboarding, or contract administration can help you connect the exercises to your work. No coding is required; the Excel activities use spreadsheet functions and structured vendor data.
